about.text: A soft, cheap fresh cheese made from the curd recovered from the whey left over after cheesemaking. In Mexico it is popular, spoils quickly, and is used like fresh cheese in gorditas, quesadillas, empanadas and sweet breads, or eaten with honey or jam.

facts.v: Whey proteins (albumin, globulin), not casein: a creamy white opaque mass
Somewhat moister than ricotta; made mainly in Cantabria, the Pyrenees and Galicia; Catalan name mató. In Río de la Plata countries requesón names a spreadable cheese and ricotta is called ricota
